REGISTER
HISTORY [S1.1] Format was CSV (header id,title,owner,amount) - replaced by S3.1.
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1] Output: json.dumps object, key 'records' = list ascending id, each exactly keys id(int),title,owner,amount(str as given); no records -> empty list.
CURRENT [S1.2] role viewer -> raise PermissionError.
CURRENT [S1.3, S3.2] admin: any project; others (non-viewer) only records with project in user projects OR owner==user['name'] (others silently skipped).
CURRENT [S1.4, S4.1] only status active; archived also exported only when params include_archived is True AND role admin; non-admin never get archived.
CURRENT [S1.5] confidential True never exported except role admin and params purpose=='audit'; other rules still apply.
CURRENT [API] export_records(records,user,params)->str; dont modify input; ignore unknown params; amount kept as given.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision: CSV chosen because finance imports into spreadsheets.
CURRENT [S2.1] params 'since' YYYY-MM-DD: only records with created >= since.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.2] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too); region compare case-insensitive in records and user regions.
CURRENT [S2.3] params max_records int>=1: first N by ascending id after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4] Obligation (now triggered by S3.1, applies): if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include top-level 'exported_by'=user['name'].
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.3] title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and every internal whitespace run replaced by single space.
CURRENT [S2.6] Obligation: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than 'audit', export must include top-level 'confidential_count' = number of confidential records in it.
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: archived storage moves to cheaper tier; no export change.
Stages 1-4 implemented in exporter/core.py (single function export_records; JSON output incl exported_by).

import json,subprocess,sys
p='/task/workspace/exporter/core.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("(st == 'archived' and params.get('include_archived') is True)","(st == 'archived' and role == 'admin' and params.get('include_archived') is True)")
s=s.replace("if r.get('region') == 'eu' and 'eu' not in (user.get('regions') or []):","if str(r.get('region') or '').lower() == 'eu' and 'eu' not in [str(x).lower() for x in (user.get('regions') or [])]:")

open(p,'w').write(s)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','discover','-s','/task/fixtures/current-tests'],cwd='/task/workspace',capture_output=True,text=True)
print(r.stderr[-1500:])
c=json.load(open('/task/workspace/context.json'))
reg=c['entries'][0]['body']
reg=reg.replace("CURRENT [S1.4] only status active unless params include_archived is True (then archived too).","CURRENT [S1.4, S4.1] only status active; archived also exported only when params include_archived is True AND role admin; non-admin never get archived.")
reg=reg.replace("CURRENT [S2.2] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too).","CURRENT [S2.2, S4.2] region 'eu' exported only if 'eu' in user['regions'] (admins too); region compare case-insensitive in records and user regions.")
reg=reg.replace("CURRENT [S2.5] title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.","CURRENT [S2.5, S4.3] title stripped of leading/trailing whitespace and every internal whitespace run replaced by single space.")
c['entries']=[{'id':'register','role':'summary','body':reg},{'id':'progress','role':'note','body':'Stages 1-4 implemented in exporter/core.py (single function export_records; JSON output incl exported_by).'}]
json.dump(c,open('/task/workspace/context.json','w'))
print(reg)
